verses.text: Di elder to di chosen lady and to her pikin dem, wey I love in truth, and no be me only, but also all those wey know di truth;
for di sake of di truth wey dey stay inside us, and e go dey with us forever.
Grace, mercy and peace go dey with us from Papa God and from Lord Jesus Christ, Papa God Pikin, in truth and love.
I dey very happy say I don find some of your pikin dem dey walk in truth, just as we receive commandment from Papa God.
Now I beg you, lady, no be as if I dey write new commandment to you, but di one wey we get from di beginning, say make we love each other.
Dis na love, say make we walk according to im commandments. Dis na di commandment, as una don hear from di beginning, say make una walk inside am.
For plenty deceivers don go out enter di world, dem wey no confess say Jesus Christ dey come inside flesh. Dis na di deceiver and di antichrist.
Make una watch out, so that una no go lose wetin we don work for, but make una receive full reward.
Anybody wey go beyond and no stay inside di teaching of Christ no get God. Anybody wey stay inside di teaching, dat one get both Papa God and di Pikin.
If anybody come to una and no bring dis teaching, no receive am enter your house, and no greet am;
for anybody wey greet am dey share for im evil works.
Though I get plenty things to write to una, I no wan use paper and ink, but I hope to come to una and talk face to face, so that our joy go full.
Di pikin dem of your chosen sister dey greet you.
